visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing glasses and a black jacket is standing in front of a colorful claw machine labeled 'LUCKY CATCH'. He is focused on the joystick, and the scene is brightly lit with indoor arcade lighting. Background elements include other machines and various toy boxes inside the display. (2) The man operates the claw, which descends and interacts with several prize boxes including a 'Crayon Shin-chan' branded mini-chair box. He watches intently as the metallic claw attempts to grip the edge of a box. (3) The claw successfully pulls a black-and-red box towards the exit chute. The man's facial expression shifts from concentration to anticipation. (4) After several attempts, the claw successfully drops a box into the bin. The man leans down excitedly to retrieve his prize, showing high energy and a wide smile. (5) He holds up a large box for a toy claw machine named 'GRAB-IT!' to the camera, presenting it proudly. He is seen from a medium shot, with the prize clearly visible in his hands.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat and bouncy electronic synth BGM begins, setting a playful tone. A male voice speaks in Mandarin with moderate energy, describing a plan. (2) A sharp mechanical 'click' and a sliding sound occur as the game claw moves. The man emits short, curious 'Oh' sounds. (3) Rhythmic, repetitive synth pulses continue. A female voice chimes in rhythmically, mimicking a catchy chant. (4) A loud 'clatter' SFX of a prize hitting the collection box is immediately followed by a high-pitched 'Ahhh!' scream and an enthusiastic 'YA!' from the male speaker. (5) The male voice becomes narrative and explanatory over the continuing BGM, mixed with the female voice questioning the cost. The audio concludes with energetic talking and fading music.
